expectations.note: With playback active in a different folder, the accessible jump action was present; tapping it navigated to /opt/nothingness/media and brought the playing row 50 into view.
In /opt/nothingness/media with playing track 10/47 off-screen, the row was absent from the visible list and no jump action was exposed, so the same-folder hardening case failed.
With playing track 05/53 fully visible and unclipped, the screenshot and semantics showed the row on-screen and no active jump action.
After the fixture ended, playback state showed isPlaying false and songInfo null; the semantics contained no jump action.
The active cross-folder affordance was a semantics button labeled "jump to now-playing folder".
The stable before screenshot showed /opt/nothingness with the playing track's media row absent while the jump glyph was visible.
The stable after screenshot showed /opt/nothingness/media with the playing row 50 visible and highlighted.
The candidate produced no final write-up claims; there were therefore no unsupported behavioral claims to trace.
On-screen folder taps changed between /opt/nothingness and /opt/nothingness/media, and pause/resume/next/previous left playback live with the expected queue state.
The final live runtime responded normally with no overflow reports after navigation, playback controls, and jump activation.
